description: Street Light Retrofits (2014) is a dataset listed in City of Boston open data portal (Analyze Boston), an open data portal, published or maintained by Public Works Department. The Street Lighting Division of Public works began converting the City's streetlights to more cost efficient and environmentally friendly Light Emitting Diode (LED) technology in the fall of 2010. The LED lights last longer, reduce carbon emissions and energy use by 60 percent, and provide a more targeted light to the streets. Coverage: Boston, Massachusetts. The portal files it under the publisher Public Works Department. Its tags are efficiency, energy, environment, hubhacks, legacy portal. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2025-05-21 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License (PDDL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-boston-portal.
